title: Bringing back a Google Drive backup from the welcome screen is never tested beyond two lines of words

expected: A phone test that finds a backup, asks before replacing the workouts on the phone, restores it and opens the app; plus the no-backup, cancel and gym-copy paths, and a check that Drive access stays limited to the app's own file.
how_often: every new phone with a backup
fix_line: Add a phone test of the welcome Google sign-in with a test Drive backup, covering restore, replace, none and cancel

title: The phone sign-in privacy promises are tested in the wrong place, so the tests pass while the promises are broken
what: The phone test checks only that Profile shows no mobile number after joining. The number is saved on the member's gym link, which no test looks at. The line 'You pay nothing, and we never message you.' is never checked, and nothing checks that no WhatsApp message goes to the number later.
expected: Tests that look where the number could really be kept (the gym link and the server), and that check the never-message promise against what the server sends after the check.
fix_line: Check the gym link and the server reply in the sign-in test, and add a check of the never-message line

title: The 'Which routine?' question on Log a past workout is never tested
what: No test opens Log a past workout for a member on a plan and checks the routine chips: one per plan day in order, no rest day, a None chip, a pick and un-pick, and the editor opening with that routine's exercises. Tests only check what is saved once a routine is passed in.
expected: A test that shows the chips for the followed plan only, leaves out rest days, and opens the editor with the routine's exercises in plan order.
fix_line: Add a test of the sheet with a followed plan holding a rest day, and of the editor it opens

title: The weigh-in and measures checks are never tested: bad numbers, an empty entry, the replace warning
what: No test types a zero or letter body weight, saves an empty measures row, or sees the warning that the day already has a weigh-in. The words 'Check the numbers' and 'Nothing to save' appear in no test. Only the data rule of one weigh-in per day is checked.
expected: Tests that refuse a zero or letter weight and an empty row with the shown words, and that show the replace warning before a second weigh-in on a day.
fix_line: Add tests of the add-measures checks and the replace warning
